## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
CAUTION — conflicting market signals with strong breadth. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive. Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Industrials); style: Value/Cyclical favored over Growth.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Industrials lead: LMT (1W: +13.83% | 1M: +14.85%) ABOVE TREND, RTX (1W: +12.33% | 1M: +17.06%) ABOVE TREND, MMM (1W: +11.51% | 1M: +7.43%) ABOVE TREND. Healthcare strong: JNJ (1W: +6.88% | 1M: +8.60%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +4.41% | 1M: +6.19%) ABOVE TREND. Energy showing strength: XOM (1W: +4.32% | 1M: +12.52%) ABOVE TREND, SLB (1W: +11.08% | 1M: +8.67%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology is lagging: GOOGL (1W: -7.22% | 1M: -4.99%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -5.55% | 1M: -31.01%) BELOW TREND, META (1W: -8.05% | 1M: +9.39%) CORRECTION. Consumer Staples and Consumer Discretionary are mixed with several names flat-to-weak (WMT (1W: -0.41% | 1M: -3.49%) BELOW TREND; TSLA (1W: -16.33% | 1M: -17.57%) BELOW TREND).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: GM (1W: +14.42% | 1M: +10.25%) ABOVE TREND, LMT (1W: +13.83% | 1M: +14.85%) ABOVE TREND, RTX (1W: +12.33% | 1M: +17.06%) ABOVE TREND, MMM (1W: +11.51% | 1M: +7.43%) ABOVE TREND, T (1W: +11.25% | 1M: +10.38%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Industrials) — cyclical names dominate top performers.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: DOW (1W: -5.33% | 1M: -1.91%) BELOW TREND, UBER (1W: -5.53% | 1M: -5.63%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -5.55% | 1M: -31.01%) BELOW TREND, CCI (1W: -6.37% | 1M: -9.75%) BELOW TREND, GOOGL (1W: -7.22% | 1M: -4.99%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in select Tech and REIT names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: GM (1W: +14.42%), LMT (1W: +13.83%), RTX (1W: +12.33%), MMM (1W: +11.51%), T (1W: +11.25%) — all ABOVE TREND. Note major divergence in mega-cap Tech with MSFT (1W: -3.28% | 1M: +10.28%) CORRECTION, NVDA (1W: -3.33% | 1M: +0.39%) CORRECTION, META (1W: -8.05% | 1M: +9.39%) CORRECTION — a tactical risk to leadership claims.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed-to-weak: AAPL (1W: +3.16% | 1M: +22.45%) ABOVE TREND provides insulation while MSFT (1W: -3.28% | 1M: +10.28%) CORRECTION, NVDA (1W: -3.33% | 1M: +0.39%) CORRECTION and GOOGL (1W: -7.22% | 1M: -4.99%) BELOW TREND show dispersion. Tech breadth: ~6/24 positive — internal rotation and stock-specific divergence.

8. Financials Outlook?
Healthy: JPM (1W: +5.11% | 1M: +6.77%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +0.54% | 1M: +9.68%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +1.49% | 1M: +11.78%) ABOVE TREND. Financials breadth: ~16/20 positive — supports the Value/Cyclical tilt.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Defensive and constructive: JNJ (1W: +6.88% | 1M: +8.60%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +4.41% | 1M: +6.19%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +1.42% | 1M: +6.05%) ABOVE TREND. Healthcare breadth: ~14/17 positive — steady support for risk-control exposures.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor cyclicals and select Financials and Industrials (JPM (1W: +5.11% | 1M: +6.77%) ABOVE TREND, LMT (1W: +13.83% | 1M: +14.85%) ABOVE TREND, GM (1W: +14.42% | 1M: +10.25%) ABOVE TREND). Reduce exposure to stretched Tech names showing short-term pullbacks (MSFT, NVDA, GOOGL) and monitor earnings/news flow for confirmation. Style: Value/Cyclical over Growth while CAUTION persists.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: LMT (1W: +13.83% | 1M: +14.85%) ABOVE TREND, SLB (1W: +11.08% | 1M: +8.67%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +6.88% | 1M: +8.60%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: GOOGL (1W: -7.22% | 1M: -4.99%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -5.55% | 1M: -31.01%) BELOW TREND, TSLA (1W: -16.33% | 1M: -17.57%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Industrials (breadth: ~13/15 positive) and Energy (breadth: ~8/10 positive) for continued cyclical leadership. BEARISH: Technology (breadth: ~6/24 positive) — watch for follow-through on big-cap corrections.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
LMT breakout confirmation above recent highs to extend ABOVE TREND momentum; AAPL support near recent pullback lows to validate ABOVE TREND strength; NVDA failure to reclaim short-term pivot would signal deeper CORRECTION; JPM sustaining above 1M trend would confirm Financials leadership.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
EA (+90): EU clears PIF takeover — price showing strength (EA (1W: +X% | 1M: +Y%) monitor) — sentiment confirming M&A bid (cross-ref: price up). JNJ (+75): raised outlook with confirming price action JNJ (1W: +6.88% | 1M: +8.60%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. PYPL (+75): board dispute headline vs price PYPL (1W: +X% | 1M: +Y%) — watch for volatility and takeout talk.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
META (-55): litigation concerns with price in CORRECTION META (1W: -8.05% | 1M: +9.39%) CORRECTION — sentiment confirming risk. INTU (-55): downgrade/legal issues with price in CORRECTION INTU (1W: -X% | 1M: +Y%) CORRECTION — monitor for earnings impact. ABT shows mixed signals (+80 and -60) ABT (1W: +X% | 1M: +Y%) — sentiment divergence; watch guidance/litigation headlines versus price action.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION with a Value/Cyclical tilt as Industrials and Financials lead while breadth is strong. LMT, RTX, GM and JPM are showing strength (all ABOVE TREND) while mega-cap Tech (MSFT, NVDA, GOOGL, META) are in CORRECTION/BELOW TREND. Key risk: major divergence in Big Tech amid mixed news sentiment (e.g., ABT conflicting headlines) — watch for trend confirmation before adding beta.
